test_title: PYST 06: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has its faces marked by numbers 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9. Two positions of the same dice are shown below. Which of the given statements follows?

I) The sum of face 9 and the face opposite to it is a multiple of 3.

II) Face 8 has a prime number as its opposite face.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b332c23091dc8d4954eea207cd25a87f21ad4e91e39dd1ce34113ad0fed1fdb6.png]

options.text: Both statements I and II follow.
Neither statement I nor II follows.

solution:
Logic: If two dice have the same face value in the given image then their clockwise or anticlockwise wise number are known as opposite numbers in dice.

The faces and the numbers opposite to the given faces are as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62dfe7c010b0e4ea3a8bd2124f8b684cb52c71ed4770eb573dded35de20919aa.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a698de86e36cbc1143282ca26ced041e190f615a49e7d489185a95592fc94335.png] 

We see that, face 6 is opposite to face 9, face 7 is opposite to face 4, and face 5 is opposite to face 8. 

The given statements are-

I) The sum of face 9 and the face opposite to it is a multiple of 3. Face 6 is opposite to face 9, the sum total of which is 15. 15 is a multiple of 3. This statement is **true**. 

II) Face 8 has a prime number as its opposite face. Face 5 is opposite to face 8. 5 is a prime number. This statement is true.

Therefore, we see that both the statements I and II follow. 

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
